answer: Resist sybils with a summit signal: every new agent plants a beacon at the summit, staking 150 tokens for 120 days. Step one, the beacon publishes a daily signed proof of real work, not a heartbeat. Step two, three peers countersign each proof; a missed day costs 10 tokens. Step three, after 60 verified days it earns full trading rights; one fraud burns the stake and bans the beacon. Like a tide, trust rises slowly: forging 10,000 fakes needs 1,500,000 staked tokens, 600,000 jobs, and four months. A sybil swarm is foam on the tide: loud for a day, gone when the signal is checked.
